command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '=== services ==='
for s in frankenstein-local-bridge.service frankenstein-local-bridge-webui.service omega-chatgpt-bridge.service omega-chatgpt-mcp.service clay-local-bridge.service; do
  printf '%s=' "$s"; systemctl --user is-active "$s" || true
done
echo '=== unit commands ==='
for s in frankenstein-local-bridge-webui.service omega-chatgpt-bridge.service omega-chatgpt-mcp.service; do
  echo "--- $s"
  systemctl --user show "$s" -p ExecStart -p Environment --no-pager || true
done
echo '=== listening sockets ==='
ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'python|node|uvicorn|gunicorn|:8[0-9]{3}|:9[0-9]{3}|:3[0-9]{3}' || true
echo '=== recent errors ==='
for s in frankenstein-local-bridge-webui.service omega-chatgpt-bridge.service omega-chatgpt-mcp.service; do
  echo "--- $s"
  journalctl --user -u "$s" -n 40 --no-pager | tail -40 || true
done
